description: Compact and efficient. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Short connecting link between entry and living area. Kitchen: L-shaped or U-shaped with extended counter run, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. Two cooks can work simultaneously on separate counter runs. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: split seating-kitchen-dining, kitchen on side wall. Seating: Dining table with four chairs in the upper-right living zone; a round table/seating near the top centre. No clear sofa visible.. Dining table (4 seats). TV on wall right of entry. Cook may see TV from cooking position. Diners do not face the TV. Entry: direct into living, first thing visible on arrival is living area. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Double bedroom — accessed via own door off corridor, no walk-in wardrobe. Double bedroom at the rear — maximum distance from entry, best acoustic separation from living activity. Storage: no wardrobe — very limited storage. One bathroom (shower, bathtub, and toilet). Bathroom accessed directly from the living area — no private corridor. Single bathroom — all household members share one shower, sequential morning routine. Suits: singles or couples. Not suitable for: families with children (only one bedroom); people needing a home office (no desk space and limited rooms); those requiring ample storage (no wardrobe, very limited storage); roommates sharing (single bedroom only).
